data.title: Transportation — Beginner · Lesson 1
data.subject: transportation
data.lyrics:
[Intro]
Hey, let's get this party started… on wheels!

[Hook]
Wheels spinning… Ruedas girando
Let's go… Vámonos
Birthday fun… Fiesta de cumpleaños
Here we go… Aquí vamos
Cruising to the beat.

[Verse]
Happy birthday… Feliz cumpleaños
Shout it out, everybody scream.
The car… El coche
Riding smooth, feeling free.
The bus… El autobús
Packed with friends and family.
Streetlights glowing, music's loud,
Dancing in the crowd.

[Hook]
Wheels spinning… Ruedas girando
Let's go… Vámonos
Birthday fun… Fiesta de cumpleaños
Here we go… Aquí vamos
Cruising to the beat.

[Verse]
The train… El tren
Whistles blowing, night is young.
The airplane… El avión
Flying high, touching the sky.
The bicycle… La bicicleta
Riding through the park, feeling alive.
Laughter echoes, stars above,
Filled with joy and love.

[Bridge]
Through the city, through the night,
Every turn feels so right.
Come on, friends, together on the road… Vamos, amigos, juntos en el camino
Celebrating life, feeling the rhythm.
